import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULO = 1000000007;
    static long number;
    static int base;
    static int[][] m = new int[31][31];

    static class MatrixType {
        int[][] matrix = new int[31][31];

        MatrixType multiply(MatrixType other) {
            MatrixType product = new MatrixType();
            for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= base; k++) {
                        sum += (long) this.matrix[i][k] * other.matrix[k][j];
                    }
                    product.matrix[i][j] = (int) (sum % MODULO);
                }
            }
            return product;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        number = sc.nextLong();
        base = sc.nextInt();

        int[] digits = new int[64];
        int digitCount = 0;
        long tempNumber = number;
        while (tempNumber != 0) {
            digits[digitCount++] = (int) (tempNumber % base);
            tempNumber /= base;
        }

        MatrixType[][] matricesA = new MatrixType[65][30];
        MatrixType[][] matricesP = new MatrixType[65][30];
        MatrixType[][] matricesS = new MatrixType[65][30];
        MatrixType result = new MatrixType();

        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            result.matrix[i][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                matricesA[0][i] = new MatrixType();
                matricesA[0][i].matrix[j][j] = 1;
                matricesA[0][i].matrix[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < digitCount; i++) {
            matricesP[i - 1][0] = matricesA[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < base; j++) {
                matricesP[i - 1][j] = matricesP[i - 1][j - 1].multiply(matricesA[i - 1][j]);
            }
            matricesS[i - 1][base - 1] = matricesA[i - 1][base - 1];
            for (int j = base - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                matricesS[i - 1][j] = matricesA[i - 1][j].multiply(matricesS[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
                matricesA[i][j] = matricesS[i - 1][j];
                if (j > 0) {
                    matricesA[i][j] = matricesA[i][j].multiply(matricesP[i - 1][j - 1]);
                }
            }
        }

        int idx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            result.matrix[i][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = digitCount - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; j++) {
                result = result.multiply(matricesA[i][idx]);
                idx = (idx + 1) % base;
            }
        }

        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            total = (total + result.matrix[i][base]) % MODULO;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
